desc:
🐠 The tanks have cracked, and the animals are EVERYWHERE! Time to Clean the Aquarium!

🫧 Pick up animals and toss them into their matching tanks!
🐢 Sort cute axolotls, turtles, sharks, and more!
🔨 Repair broken glass and stop the leaks!
✨ Discover rare animal variants!
⬆️ Earn coins and upgrade your cleaning abilities!
👥 Clean solo or team up with friends!

Turn a flooded mess into a spotless aquarium—one animal at a time!
